blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Electrostatics and Current Electricity) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Electrostatics is the study of the phenomena and properties of electric charges that are:
(Electrostatics un electric charges ke mazahir aur khususiyaat ka mutala hai jo:)

options.text: yaksaan velocity se chal rahe hon

blocks.explanation: Electrostatics saakin (at rest) charges ka mutala hai; harkat karte charges electric current banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Electrostatics is the study of phenomena and properties of electric charges at rest.

blocks.prompt:
2 Any amount of charge q on a body is given by q = Ne, where N is:
(Kisi jism par charge q = Ne hota hai, jahan N:)
blocks.explanation: e sab se chhota aazad charge hai, is liye har charge e ka poora (integer) guna hai: q = Ne, N integer.

book_ref.quote: This charge (e) is the smallest amount of free charge that has been discovered.

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following charges can exist on a body? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
(In mein se kaun sa charge kisi jism par mumkin hai? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))
blocks.explanation: 4.8 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 3e, yani e ka integer guna; baaqi se N = 1.5, 0.5 aur 2.5 aata hai (q = Ne).

book_ref.quote: Charges of larger magnitude are built up on an object by adding or removing electrons.

blocks.prompt:
4 How many electrons must be removed from a neutral body to give it a charge of +3.2 μC? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
(Kisi neutral jism ko +3.2 μC charge dene ke liye kitne electrons nikalne honge? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))

book_ref.quote: Thus, any amount of charge q is an integer multiple of e, i.e.,

blocks.prompt:
5 According to Coulomb's law, the force between two point charges is inversely proportional to:
(Coulomb ke qanoon ke mutabiq do point charges ke darmiyan force kis ke ulat mutanasib (inversely proportional) hai?)

options.text: un ke darmiyan faasle ke murabba (square) ke

blocks.explanation: F = k q₁q₂/r²: charges ke hasil-e-zarb ke seedha aur faasle ke murabba (square) ke ulat mutanasib (9.1).

book_ref.quote: The force between two-point charges is directly proportional to the product of the magnitudes of charges

blocks.prompt:
6 The Coulomb force between two point charges acts:
(Do point charges ke darmiyan Coulomb force kis rukh mein amal karti hai?)

options.text: dono charges ko milane wali line ke saath

blocks.explanation: Force hamesha dono point charges ko milane wali line ke saath amal karti hai (9.1).

book_ref.quote: The force F always acts along the line joining the two point charges

blocks.prompt:
7 The value of the permittivity of free space ε₀ in SI units is:
(SI units mein free space ki permittivity ε₀ ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²; 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻² to k = 1/4πε₀ hai (9.1).

book_ref.quote: In SI units, its value is 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻².

blocks.prompt:
8 The constant k in Coulomb's law depends upon:
(Coulomb ke qanoon mein constant k kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: charges ke darmiyan medium aur units ke system par
sirf charges ke darmiyan faasle par

blocks.explanation: k darmiyani medium ki nauiyat aur units ke system par munhasir hai jin mein F, q aur r naape jaate hain (9.1).

book_ref.quote: Its value depends upon the nature of medium between the two charges and system of units

blocks.prompt:
9 If F₁₂ is the force on q₁ due to q₂ and F₂₁ is the force on q₂ due to q₁, then:
(Agar F₁₂ q₂ ki wajah se q₁ par force aur F₂₁ q₁ ki wajah se q₂ par force ho, to:)
blocks.explanation: Coulomb force bahami (mutual) hai: dono forces miqdaar mein barabar aur rukh mein mukhalif, F₁₂ = −F₂₁ (Eq. 9.4).

book_ref.quote: Coulombs' force is mutual force, it means that if q₁ exerts a force on q₂

blocks.prompt:
10 Two point charges of 2 μC each are 0.3 m apart in free space. The force between them is (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(Free space mein 2 μC ke do point charges 0.3 m door hain. Un ke darmiyan force kitni hai? (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))

book_ref.quote: Coulomb's law is a fundamental principle in electrostatics that quantifies the force

blocks.prompt:
11 If the distance between two point charges is made three times, the force between them becomes:
(Agar do point charges ka faasla teen guna kar diya jaye to un ke darmiyan force kitni ho jayegi?)
blocks.explanation: F ∝ 1/r², is liye r teen guna karne se F 1/3² = 1/9 reh jati hai (Eq. 9.1).

book_ref.quote: F is the magnitude of the mutual force that acts on each of the two point charges

blocks.prompt:
12 An insulating medium placed between two charges is usually called a:
(Do charges ke darmiyan rakha gaya insulator medium aam tor par kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar medium insulator ho to use dielectric kehte hain (9.1).

book_ref.quote: If the medium is an insulator, it is usually referred as dielectric.

blocks.prompt:
13 Compared with free space, the presence of a dielectric between two charges:
(Free space ke muqable mein do charges ke darmiyan dielectric ki mojoodgi:)

options.text: force ko hamesha barha deti hai
electrostatic force ko hamesha kam karti hai
force par koi asar nahi dalti
force ka rukh ulat deti hai

blocks.explanation: Dielectric hamesha force ko aik mustaqil factor, relative permittivity εᵣ, se kam kar deta hai (9.1).

book_ref.quote: the presence of a dielectric always reduces the electrostatic force as compared with that in free space

blocks.prompt:
14 Two charges attract each other with 0.8 N in free space. When the same charges at the same distance are placed in a medium of relative permittivity 4, the force becomes:
(Do charges free space mein aik doosre ko 0.8 N se kheenchte hain. Usi faasle par εᵣ = 4 wale medium mein force kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Medium mein F = (1/4πε₀εᵣ)(q₁q₂/r²), yani εᵣ guna kam: 0.8/4 = 0.2 N (9.1, durust Eq. 9.7).

book_ref.quote: In a medium of relative permittivity εᵣ the force is F = (1/4πε₀εᵣ)(q₁q₂/r²)

blocks.prompt:
15 From the corrected Table 9.1, which material has the largest relative permittivity?
(Durust Table 9.1 ke mutabiq kis maadde ki relative permittivity sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Distilled paani ka εᵣ = 78.5 hai, baaqi maaddon se kahin zyada (Table 9.1, durust).

book_ref.quote: Transformer oil 2.1, Water (distilled) 78.5

blocks.prompt:
16 The force between two charges in air is taken equal to that in free space because:
(Hawa mein do charges ki force free space ke barabar kyun li jati hai?)

options.text: hawa ka εᵣ (1.0006) aik ke bohat qareeb hai

blocks.explanation: Hawa ka εᵣ 1.0006 hai, aik ke itna qareeb ke Eq. 9.3 maamooli ghalti se hawa mein force deti hai (9.1).

book_ref.quote: This value is so close to one that with negligible error

blocks.prompt:
17 Two perpendicular forces of 1200 N and 500 N act on a charge. The magnitude of the net force is:
(Aik charge par 1200 N aur 500 N ki do amoodi (perpendicular) forces amal karti hain. Net force ki miqdaar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = √(Fₓ² + Fᵧ²) = √(1200² + 500²) = 1300 N, jaise Example 9.1 mein.

blocks.prompt:
18 A Van de Graaff generator produces:
(Van de Graaff generator kya paida karta hai?)

options.text: zyada current par kam voltage AC
kam current par bohat zyada voltage DC
kam voltage par bohat zyada current

blocks.explanation: Yeh chalti belt se khokhle dhaati globe par charge jama kar ke kam current par bohat ziada voltage DC banata hai (9.1 box).

book_ref.quote: It was invented by American physicist Robert J. Van de Graff in 1929.

blocks.prompt:
19 The electric intensity at a point is the force experienced by:
(Kisi nuqte par electric intensity woh force hai jo kis par lagti hai?)

options.text: us nuqte par rakhe unit positive charge par
us nuqte par rakhe unit negative charge par
us nuqte par rakhe electron par
us nuqte par rakhe unit mass par

blocks.explanation: Electric intensity us nuqte par rakhe aik unit positive charge par force hai, E = F/q (9.2).

book_ref.quote: the force experienced by a unit positive charge placed at that point

blocks.prompt:
20 The SI unit of electric intensity is:
(Electric intensity ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = F/q se electric intensity ki unit newton per coulomb, N C⁻¹ hai (9.2).

book_ref.quote: the unit of electric intensity is newton per coulomb N C⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
21 A charge of 2 μC experiences a force of 6 × 10⁻³ N at a point. The electric intensity there is:
(Aik nuqte par 2 μC charge par 6 × 10⁻³ N force lagti hai. Wahan electric intensity kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The direction of E is the same as that of F.

blocks.prompt:
22 As a point gets closer to a charged body, the electric field there:
(Jaise jaise nuqta charged jism ke qareeb aata hai, wahan electric field:)
blocks.explanation: Coulomb ka qanoon batata hai ke nuqta charged jism ke qareeb ho to field taqatwar hoti hai (9.2).

book_ref.quote: Coulomb's law suggests that the field gets stronger as the point A gets closer to O

blocks.prompt:
23 Two positive charges of 9 μC and 1 μC are 4 m apart. The point between them where the field is zero lies at a distance of:
(9 μC aur 1 μC ke do positive charges 4 m door hain. In ke darmiyan field sifr hone wala nuqta kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: E₁ = E₂ se 9/(4 − d)² = 1/d², yani 3d = 4 − d aur d = 1 m chhote charge se (Example 9.2 ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Between the two charges, the fields contributed by them have opposite directions

blocks.prompt:
24 An electron (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) experiences an electric force equal to its weight. Taking g = 9.8 m s⁻², the field intensity is:
(Aik electron (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) par electric force us ke wazan ke barabar hai. g = 9.8 m s⁻² lein; field intensity kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = mg/e = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 9.8 / 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ = 5.6 × 10⁻¹¹ N C⁻¹ (Example 9.3 ka tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: Mass of proton = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg and charge, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C

blocks.prompt:
25 The idea of electric field lines was proposed by:
(Electric field lines ka tasawwur kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Electric field lines, field ka nazri naqsha, Michael Faraday ne pesh kiye (9.2).

book_ref.quote: an idea proposed by Michael Faraday

blocks.prompt:
26 The electric field lines around an isolated positive point charge are directed:
(Akele positive point charge ke gird electric field lines kis rukh mein hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Positive test charge door dhakela jata hai, is liye +q ki field radial bahar ki taraf hai (9.2, Fig. 9.5).

book_ref.quote: the electric field created by the charge +q is directed radially outward

blocks.prompt:
27 Around a negative point charge the field lines point radially inward because the force on a positive test charge is:
(Negative point charge ke gird field lines radial andar ki taraf kyun hain? Kyunke positive test charge par force:)

options.text: milane wali line par amoodi hai

blocks.explanation: −q ke qareeb positive test charge par force kashish (attraction) wali hai, is liye field andar ki taraf (9.2, Fig. 9.6).

book_ref.quote: the lines are directed radially “inward”

blocks.prompt:
28 Two electric field lines never cross each other because:
(Do electric field lines kabhi aik doosre ko kaat'ti kyun nahi?)

options.text: har nuqte par E ki sirf aik simt hoti hai
jahan lines milti hain wahan field sifr hai

blocks.explanation: Agar lines kaat'tin to us nuqte par E ki aik se zyada simt hoti, jo na-mumkin hai (9.2).

book_ref.quote: No two lines cross each other.

blocks.prompt:
29 The direction of the electric field at a point on a curved field line is given by:
(Kisi muraqqab (curved) field line ke nuqte par electric field ki simt kis se maloom hoti hai?)

options.text: us nuqte par line ka tangent (mamaas)
us nuqte par line ka normal (amood)
dono charges ko milane wali line

blocks.explanation: Field line ke kisi nuqte par tangent (mamaas) wahan E ki simt batata hai (9.2).

book_ref.quote: The tangent to a field line at any point gives the direction of the electric field at that point.

blocks.prompt:
30 In the field pattern of two identical positive charges, the middle region between them has:
(Do yaksaan positive charges ke field pattern mein un ke darmiyan wale hisse mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: zero field spot ya neutral zone

blocks.explanation: Yaksaan charges ke darmiyan lines aik doosre ko dhakelti lagti hain aur beech mein zero field spot (neutral zone) hota hai (9.2, Fig. 9.7).

book_ref.quote: The middle region shows the presence of a zero field spot or neutral zone.

blocks.prompt:
31 Electric field lines that are parallel and equally spaced show a field that is:
(Mutawazi aur barabar faasle wali electric field lines kaisi field zahir karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jahan lines mutawazi aur barabar faasle par hon, wahan har unit area se barabar lines guzarti hain, is liye field uniform (yaksaan) hai, maslan capacitor plates ke darmiyan (9.2).

book_ref.quote: the field lines are parallel and equally spaced

blocks.prompt:
32 The magnitude of the electric field is proportional to:
(Electric field ki miqdaar kis ke mutanasib hai?)

options.text: kisi area se amoodi guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad per unit area
area ka lehaaz kiye baghair charge se nikalne wali kul lines

blocks.explanation: Amoodi tor par guzarne wali lines ki tadaad per unit area E ki miqdaar ke mutanasib hai (9.2).

book_ref.quote: The number of lines per unit area passing perpendicularly through it is proportional to the magnitude

blocks.prompt:
33 The number of electric field lines passing through a certain element of area is called:
(Kisi area ke hisse se guzarne wali electric field lines ki tadaad ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electric flux φₑ kisi area se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad hai (9.3).

book_ref.quote: The number of the field lines passing through a certain element of area is known as electric flux

blocks.prompt:
34 The SI unit of electric flux is:
(Electric flux ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: φₑ = E·A, is liye unit (N C⁻¹)(m²) = N m² C⁻¹ hai (9.3).

book_ref.quote: is a scalar quantity. Its SI unit is N m² C⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
35 Electric flux is a scalar quantity because it is:
(Electric flux scalar quantity kyun hai?)

options.text: E aur A ka vector product
E aur vector area A ka scalar product

blocks.explanation: φₑ = E·A scalar (dot) product hai, is liye flux scalar hai (9.3).

book_ref.quote: Electric flux being a scalar product, is a scalar quantity.

blocks.prompt:
36 The electric flux through an area held parallel to the field lines is:
(Field lines ke mutawazi rakhe gaye area se electric flux kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Area lines ke mutawazi ho to koi line nahi guzarti; E aur vector area amoodi, φₑ = EA cos 90° = 0 (9.3).

book_ref.quote: area A is held parallel to field lines and, as is obvious no lines cross this area

blocks.prompt:
37 A flat area of 0.5 m² is placed in a uniform field of 200 N C⁻¹ so that its normal makes 60° with the field. The flux through it is:
(0.5 m² ka hamwaar area 200 N C⁻¹ ki uniform field mein aise rakha hai ke us ka normal field se 60° banata hai. Flux kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: φₑ = EA cos θ = 200 × 0.5 × cos 60° = 50 N m² C⁻¹ (Eq. 9.10).

book_ref.quote: θ is the angle between the field lines and the normal to the area

blocks.prompt:
38 The flux through an area is maximum when the area is held:
(Kisi area se flux zyada se zyada kab hota hai jab area ko:)

options.text: field lines ke mutawazi rakha jaye
field lines par amoodi (perpendicular) rakha jaye

blocks.explanation: Lines par amoodi rakhne se EA lines guzarti hain aur φₑ = EA, sab se zyada (9.3, Fig. 9.11 a).

book_ref.quote: area A is held perpendicular to the field lines, then EA lines pass through it

blocks.prompt:
39 The total electric flux through a closed surface enclosing a charge does not depend upon:
(Charge ko gherne wali band satah (closed surface) se kul electric flux kis par munhasir nahi?)

options.text: satah ki shakal ya geometry par

blocks.explanation: Band satah se kul flux sirf medium aur andar ke charge par munhasir hai, shakal par nahi (9.3).

book_ref.quote: total flux through a closed surface does not depend upon the shape or geometry of the closed surface

blocks.prompt:
40 A point charge q is at the centre of a sphere of radius r. If the radius is doubled, the total flux through the sphere:
(Point charge q radius r wale sphere ke markaz par hai. Radius dugna karne par sphere se kul flux:)
blocks.explanation: E ∝ 1/r² aur area 4πr² ∝ r², is liye φₑ = E × 4πr² = q/ε₀, r par munhasir nahi (Eq. 9.13).

book_ref.quote: a closed surface, in shape of a sphere of radius r due to a point charge q placed at the centre

blocks.prompt:
41 To compute the flux through a sphere with φₑ = E·A, the sphere is divided into small patches because:
(φₑ = E·A se sphere ka flux nikalne ke liye sphere ko chhote tukron (patches) mein kyun baanta jata hai?)

options.text: formula ke liye hamwaar (flat) satah chahiye

blocks.explanation: φₑ = E·A ke liye hamwaar area chahiye, is liye sphere ko chhote (taqreeban hamwaar) tukron mein baanta jata hai (9.3).

book_ref.quote: the total surface area of the sphere is divided into n small patches

blocks.prompt:
42 According to Gauss's law, the total electric flux through any closed surface is:
(Gauss ke qanoon ke mutabiq kisi bhi band satah se kul electric flux kya hai?)

options.text: andar band kul charge ka ε₀ guna
satah ke bahar charge ka 1/ε₀ guna
andar band kul charge ka 1/ε₀ guna

blocks.explanation: φₑ = Q/ε₀, jahan Q andar band kul charge hai (Eq. 9.14).

book_ref.quote: The total electric flux through any closed surface is 1/ε₀ times the total charge enclosed in it.

blocks.prompt:
43 A closed surface encloses a total charge of 8.85 μC. The total electric flux through it is (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²):
(Aik band satah ke andar kul 8.85 μC charge hai. Us se kul electric flux kitna hai? (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²))

book_ref.quote: Suppose point charges q₁, q₂, q₃, ………, qₙ are arbitrarily distributed

blocks.prompt:
44 A closed surface encloses charges of +3 μC, −5 μC and +2 μC. The total flux through it is:
(Aik band satah ke andar +3 μC, −5 μC aur +2 μC charges hain. Us se kul flux kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q = 3 − 5 + 2 = 0, is liye φₑ = Q/ε₀ = 0 (Eq. 9.14).

book_ref.quote: is the total charge enclosed by closed surface. Equation 9.14 is mathematical expression

blocks.prompt:
45 The imaginary closed surface chosen to apply Gauss's law is called:
(Gauss ka qanoon lagane ke liye chuni gayi khayali band satah ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jis nuqte par E chahiye us se guzarti khayali band satah Gaussian surface hai (9.4).

book_ref.quote: This closed surface is known as Gaussian surface.

blocks.prompt:
46 On a charged conducting sphere, the charge is:
(Charged conducting sphere par charge kahan hota hai?)

options.text: us ki satah par yaksaan phaila hota hai
poore hajm mein yaksaan phaila hota hai

blocks.explanation: Conducting sphere ka saara charge us ki satah par yaksaan phaila hota hai (9.4).

book_ref.quote: all the charge is distributed uniformly over the surface of sphere

blocks.prompt:
47 The electric field at a point outside a charged conducting sphere is the same as if:
(Charged conducting sphere ke bahar kisi nuqte par electric field aisi hai jaise:)

options.text: saara charge us ke markaz par jama ho
charge aik plane par phaila ho
sphere par koi charge na ho
charge satah ke qareeb tareen nuqte par ho

blocks.explanation: Gauss ke qanoon se bahar E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²), jaise saara charge markaz par ho (9.4).

book_ref.quote: the field at any point outside the sphere is the same as though the entire charge were concentrated at its centre

blocks.prompt:
48 A conducting sphere of radius 0.1 m carries 2 μC. The field just outside its surface is (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(0.1 m radius ke conducting sphere par 2 μC charge hai. Satah ke bilkul bahar field kitni hai? (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))

book_ref.quote: Just outside of the sphere, where r = R, i.e.,

blocks.prompt:
49 To find the field outside a charged conducting sphere of radius R, the Gaussian surface is taken as:
(R radius ke charged conducting sphere ke bahar field nikalne ke liye Gaussian surface kya li jati hai?)

options.text: r > R radius ka hum-markaz khayali sphere

blocks.explanation: Symmetry se E radial aur har hum-markaz sphere par yaksaan hai, is liye r > R wala hum-markaz (concentric) sphere liya jata hai (9.4).

book_ref.quote: Therefore, we take our Gaussian surface as an imaginary sphere with radius r greater than the radius R

blocks.prompt:
50 When a positive charge is moved against the electric field in equilibrium, the work done by the external force:
(Jab positive charge ko equilibrium mein electric field ke khilaf le jaya jaye to bairooni force ka kaam:)

options.text: us ki kinetic energy barhata hai
us ki potential energy kam karta hai
us ki electrical potential energy barhata hai

blocks.explanation: Charge yaksaan velocity se chalta hai, is liye field ke khilaf kaam us ki electrical P.E. barhata hai (9.5).

book_ref.quote: The work done by the external force against the electric field increases electrical potential energy

blocks.prompt:
51 The potential difference between two points is the work done in carrying:
(Do nuqton ke darmiyan potential difference kis cheez ko le jane ka kaam hai?)

options.text: aik unit mass ko aik nuqte se doosre tak
aik unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein aik nuqte se doosre tak
kisi bhi charge ko infinity se

blocks.explanation: ΔV = V_B − V_A = W_AB/q, equilibrium mein A se B tak unit positive charge le jane ka kaam (Eq. 9.17).

book_ref.quote: work done in carrying a unit positive charge from A to B while keeping the charge in equilibrium

blocks.prompt:
52 One volt is equal to:
(Aik volt kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 volt = 1 joule/1 coulomb (Eq. 9.19).

book_ref.quote: a potential difference of 1 volt exists between two points if work done in moving a 1 coulomb positive charge

blocks.prompt:
53 A charge of 3 μC is moved through a potential difference of 200 V. The change in its potential energy is:
(3 μC charge ko 200 V potential difference se guzara jata hai. Us ki potential energy mein tabdeeli kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Electric potential energy difference and electric potential difference between the points A and B are related as:

blocks.prompt:
54 The reference point of zero electric potential is usually taken at:
(Sifr electric potential ka hawala nuqta (reference point) aam tor par kahan liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sifr potential ka nuqta aam tor par infinity par liya jata hai (9.5).

book_ref.quote: This point is usually taken at infinity.

blocks.prompt:
55 Electric potential is a scalar quantity because:
(Electric potential scalar quantity kyun hai?)

options.text: kaam W aur charge q dono scalars hain
is ki simt zyada se kam ki taraf hai
yeh per unit charge force hai
yeh vector area par munhasir hai

blocks.explanation: V = W/q aur W aur q dono scalars hain, is liye potential aur potential difference scalars hain (9.5).

book_ref.quote: Both potential and potential differences are scalar quantities because both W and q are scalars.

blocks.prompt:
56 Bringing a charge of 2 C from infinity to a point in equilibrium needs 6 J of work. The potential at that point is:
(2 C charge ko infinity se aik nuqte tak equilibrium mein lane ke liye 6 J kaam chahiye. Us nuqte par potential kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: the work done in bringing a unit positive charge from infinity to that point keeping it in equilibrium

blocks.prompt:
57 The electric intensity is equal to:
(Electric intensity kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = −ΔV/Δd: E potential gradient ka manfi (negative) hai (Eq. 9.23).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the electric intensity is equal to the negative of the gradient of potential.

blocks.prompt:
58 The negative sign in E = −ΔV/Δd shows that E points in the direction of:
(E = −ΔV/Δd mein manfi nishan kya batata hai? E kis rukh mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manfi nishan batata hai ke E ghatte hue potential ki taraf hai (9.5).

book_ref.quote: The negative sign indicates that the direction of E is along the decreasing potential.
